name: Matsukaze Chizuru
source:
Daughter and assistant instructor of the Matsukaze sword dojo in Fukagawa, known as the sword beauty of Fukagawa. Proud, hot-tempered and a terrible liar. Her older brother has been missing for a year, and people suspect he’s the Kurotengu.

[spoiler]Upon failing to find the truth about the Kurotengu she is sold to the Rokumeirou Yoshiwara brothel and given the name Nanagiri.[/spoiler]
